<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0">
<title>TMGame Admin Panel</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
body{background:#f1f5f9;color:#0f172a}
button{border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:12px;margin:6px 0;outline:none;font-size:15px}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:#4f46e5;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,.15)}
.hidden{display:none!important}
button,.btn,.filter-btn,.side-btn,.menu{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.spin{animation:tmSpin .8s linear infinite}
.refresh-ico{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;transform-origin:50% 50%;will-change:transform}
.refresh-ico svg{display:block;width:24px;height:24px;overflow:visible}
.refresh-ico.spin{animation:tmRefreshSpin .72s linear infinite}
#refreshBtn[data-busy="1"]{cursor:wait;opacity:.78}
@keyframes tmSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes tmRefreshSpin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.btn{padding:11px 16px;border-radius:11px;background:#4f46e5;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;transition:.15s}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn.green{background:#16a34a}
.btn.red{background:#dc2626}
.btn.orange{background:#ea580c}
.btn.dark{background:#1e293b}
.btn.gray{background:#64748b}
.btn.small{padding:7px 11px;font-size:12px}
.btn.copy{background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;padding:5px 9px;font-size:11px}
.login-screen{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#312e81)}
.login-box{width:100%;max-width:400px;background:#fff;padding:32px;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.logo{color:#4f46e5;font-size:30px;font-weight:900}
.login-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin:22px 0 12px}
.error{color:#dc2626;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px}
.header{height:64px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 18px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50}
.header-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.menu{font-size:24px;background:none;color:#334155}
.header-user{color:#64748b;font-size:13px;max-width:140px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.sidebar{position:fixed;top:64px;bottom:0;left:0;width:240px;background:#0f172a;padding:16px 12px;z-index:40;overflow-y:auto}
.side-btn{width:100%;text-align:left;padding:13px 14px;margin-bottom:4px;border-radius:11px;background:transparent;color:#94a3b8;font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.side-btn:hover,.side-btn.active{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff}
.main{margin-left:240px;padding:22px;max-width:1400px}
.page{display:none}
.page.active{display:block}
.page-title{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:20px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.stat{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.stat-label{color:#64748b;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.stat-value{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;margin-top:6px}
.card{background:#fff;padding:20px;border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.card-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}
.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.form-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#334155;margin-bottom:2px;display:block}
.table-wrap{width:100%;overflow-x:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:800px}
th,td{padding:12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0;text-align:left;font-size:13px;vertical-align:middle}
th{background:#f8fafc;font-weight:800;color:#475569}
.actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.status{display:inline-block;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.pending{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e}
.approved,.paid,.active-status,.resolved{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.rejected,.blocked,.closed{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
.inprogress{background:#dbeafe;color:#1e40af}
.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.filter-btn{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:20px;background:#f1f5f9;color:#475569;font-weight:700;font-size:12px}
.filter-btn.active{background:#4f46e5;color:#fff}
.id-box{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:110px}
.id-text{word-break:break-all;font-size:11px}
.user-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.user-name{font-weight:800}
.user-email{color:#64748b;font-size:11px}
.money{font-weight:800}
.tournament-admin{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:16px}
.t-card{background:#fff;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.05)}
.t-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;background:#e2e8f0}
.t-body{padding:16px}
.badges{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.badge{background:#e0e7ff;color:#3730a3;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.info-box{background:#f8fafc;border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#475569;line-height:1.5;font-size:14px}
.empty{padding:28px;text-align:center;color:#64748b}
.modal-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,23,42,.55);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;z-index:200}
.modal{width:100%;max-width:520px;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:24px}
.modal-title{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:16px}
.toggle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e2e8f0}
.toggle-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.toggle-label{font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.toggle-status{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px}
.toggle-status.on{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}
.toggle-status.off{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
.reason-box{margin-top:8px;display:none}
.reason-box.show{display:block}
@media(max-width:900px){
.sidebar{width:0;overflow:hidden;padding:16px 0;transition:.25s}
.sidebar.open{width:240px;padding:16px 12px}
.main{margin-left:0;padding:14px}
.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* Premium visual layer — functionality and selectors remain unchanged */
:root{
  --ink:#10172b;
  --muted:#6b7690;
  --line:#e7eaf2;
  --surface:#ffffff;
  --surface-soft:#f7f8fc;
  --brand:#5b4cf0;
  --brand-deep:#3f32bf;
  --brand-soft:#eeedff;
  --navy:#11182d;
  --shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(26,34,72,.07);
  --shadow-hover:0 20px 42px rgba(26,34,72,.13);
}
html{background:#f5f6fb;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 92% 0%,rgba(91,76,240,.08),transparent 28rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#f8f9fd 0%,#f2f4fa 100%);
  color:var(--ink);
  letter-spacing:-.01em;
}
body:before{
  content:"";
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  opacity:.35;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(91,76,240,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(91,76,240,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000,transparent 78%);
}
button,input,select,textarea{transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,transform .2s ease,opacity .2s ease}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(91,76,240,.2);outline-offset:2px}
input,select,textarea{
  border-color:#dfe3ed;
  background:#fbfcfe;
  color:var(--ink);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgba(16,24,48,.02);
}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:#9aa3b6}
input:hover,select:hover,textarea:hover{border-color:#c9cfea}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:var(--brand);
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(91,76,240,.12),0 8px 18px rgba(50,44,140,.05);
}
.btn{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#4f3ed7);
  border:1px solid rgba(63,50,191,.18);
  border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(79,62,215,.18);
  letter-spacing:.01em;
}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(79,62,215,.25);filter:saturate(1.08)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(0) scale(.98);box-shadow:0 5px 10px rgba(79,62,215,.16)}
.btn.green{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#22b66f,#139657);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(19,150,87,.16)}
.btn.red{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f05c68,#d93647);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(217,54,71,.16)}
.btn.orange{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59b3d,#e36b20);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(227,107,32,.16)}
.btn.dark{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#293552,#172238);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(23,34,56,.15)}
.btn.gray{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8893aa,#65718a);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(101,113,138,.15)}
.btn.copy{background:var(--brand-soft);color:var(--brand-deep);border:1px solid #ddd9ff;box-shadow:none}
.btn.copy:hover{background:#e2dfff;box-shadow:none}
.login-screen{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 18%,rgba(128,115,255,.32),transparent 25rem),
    radial-gradient(circle at 88% 86%,rgba(51,207,196,.16),transparent 24rem),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#0d1428 0%,#191947 58%,#241b5d 100%);
}
.login-screen:before,.login-screen:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  width:22rem;
  height:22rem;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  border-radius:50%;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.login-screen:before{top:-9rem;right:-5rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 42px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 0 0 84px rgba(255,255,255,.018)}
.login-screen:after{bottom:-13rem;left:-7rem}
.login-box{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  max-width:430px;
  padding:38px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-radius:28px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  animation:panelIn .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}
.logo{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#36cfc2);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;
  color:transparent;
  letter-spacing:-.045em;
}
.login-box>div:nth-child(2){color:#7d879c!important}
.login-title{color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.035em}
.header{
  height:72px;
  padding:0 24px;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(226,229,239,.85);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(24,32,65,.05);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
}
.header-left{gap:15px}
.menu{
  width:38px;
  height:38px;
  border-radius:11px;
  color:#4d5871;
  background:#f3f4fa;
  font-size:20px;
}
.menu:hover{background:var(--brand-soft);color:var(--brand)}
.header .logo{font-size:21px!important}
.header-user{
  padding:8px 12px;
  border:1px solid #e6e8f0;
  border-radius:999px;
  color:#59647b;
  background:#fafbfe;
}
.sidebar{
  top:72px;
  width:256px;
  padding:22px 14px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%,rgba(109,91,255,.24),transparent 18rem),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#121a32,#0c1326);
  box-shadow:16px 0 34px rgba(13,19,40,.08);
}
.sidebar:before{
  content:"CONTROL CENTER";
  display:block;
  padding:0 13px 14px;
  color:#66728e;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:800;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
}
.side-btn{
  position:relative;
  padding:12px 14px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  color:#9ba6be;
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:all .2s ease;
}
.side-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff;transform:translateX(3px)}
.side-btn.active{
  color:#fff;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(103,88,255,.95),rgba(79,62,215,.76));
  border-color:rgba(175,166,255,.2);
  box-shadow:0 9px 18px rgba(49,37,151,.25);
}
.side-btn.active:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:-14px;
  top:10px;
  bottom:10px;
  width:3px;
  border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;
  background:#8f86ff;
}
.main{margin-left:256px;padding:32px 32px 44px;max-width:1480px}
.page.active{animation:pageIn .35s ease both}
.page-title{
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:13px;
  margin-bottom:24px;
  color:#151d35;
  font-size:29px;
  letter-spacing:-.045em;
}
.page-title:before{content:"";width:5px;height:29px;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(#6c5cff,#37cbbb);box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(91,76,240,.24)}
.stats{gap:16px;margin-bottom:26px}
.stat{
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  padding:20px;
  border:1px solid rgba(226,229,239,.9);
  border-radius:19px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  transition:transform .24s ease,box-shadow .24s ease;
}
.stat:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  right:-22px;
  bottom:-25px;
  width:84px;
  height:84px;
  border:1px solid rgba(91,76,240,.08);
  border-radius:50%;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(91,76,240,.025);
}
.stat:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover)}
.stat-label{color:#7b8498;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
.stat-value{color:#151d35;font-size:27px;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.card,.t-card{
  border:1px solid rgba(226,229,239,.88);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.card{padding:23px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:20px}
.card-title{color:#1b2440;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.form-label{color:#68738b;letter-spacing:.02em}
.table-wrap{border:1px solid #edf0f5;border-radius:15px}
table{min-width:820px}
th,td{padding:14px 13px;border-bottom-color:#edf0f5}
th{
  background:#f8f9fc;
  color:#69748a;
  font-size:11px;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
tbody tr{transition:background .18s ease}
tbody tr:hover{background:#fafaff}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
.actions{gap:7px}
.status{padding:6px 11px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.pending{background:#fff4d6;color:#9a6700}
.approved,.paid,.active-status,.resolved{background:#ddf8e9;color:#137145}
.rejected,.blocked,.closed{background:#ffe3e6;color:#b3283d}
.inprogress{background:#e3efff;color:#2455a6}
.filter-row{gap:9px;margin-bottom:18px}
.filter-btn{
  border:1px solid #e5e8f0;
  background:#f8f9fc;
  color:#6c7790;
  transition:all .2s ease;
}
.filter-btn:hover{border-color:#cfcaff;color:var(--brand);background:#f5f3ff}
.filter-btn.active{border-color:var(--brand);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6758ff,#4f3ed7);box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(79,62,215,.16)}
.id-text{color:#59657c}
.user-name{color:#1a2440}
.user-email{color:#8a94a8}
.money{color:#1e2b4a}
.info-box{background:#f7f8fc;border:1px solid #eceef5;color:#64708a}
.empty{color:#8993a7}
.tournament-admin{gap:20px}
.t-card{border-radius:20px;transition:transform .24s ease,box-shadow .24s ease}
.t-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover)}
.t-card img{background:#e8eaf2}
.t-body{padding:19px}
.badge{background:var(--brand-soft);color:var(--brand-deep);border:1px solid #e1ddff}
.modal-bg{align-items:center;padding:18px;background:rgba(9,14,31,.68);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.modal{
  max-height:88vh;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  border-radius:24px;
  box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  animation:modalIn .3s ease both;
}
.toggle-row{border-bottom-color:#edf0f5}
.toggle-status{letter-spacing:.08em}
.toggle-status.on{background:#ddf8e9;color:#137145}
.toggle-status.off{background:#ffe3e6;color:#b3283d}
.reason-box{animation:pageIn .25s ease both}
@keyframes panelIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(7px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes modalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .header{padding:0 16px}
  .sidebar{top:72px}
  .main{padding:22px 16px 34px}
  .page-title{font-size:25px}
}
@media(max-width:540px){
  .login-box{padding:30px 22px;border-radius:24px}
  .card{padding:18px;border-radius:18px}
  .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
  .stat{padding:15px}
  .stat-value{font-size:23px}
  .modal-bg{padding:0;align-items:flex-end}
  .modal{border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;padding:20px}
}

/* Mobile Admin Panel correction — off-canvas navigation and full-width content */
@media(max-width:900px){
  body{overflow-x:hidden}
  .header{
    height:68px!important;
    min-height:68px;
    padding:0 14px!important;
  }
  .header-left{min-width:0;gap:10px}
  .header .logo{
    max-width:190px;
    overflow:hidden;
    text-overflow:ellipsis;
    white-space:nowrap;
    font-size:18px!important;
  }
  .header-user{
    max-width:132px;
    padding:7px 10px;
    font-size:11px;
  }
  .menu{
    flex:0 0 38px;
    width:38px;
    height:38px;
  }
  .sidebar{
    top:68px!important;
    left:0!important;
    bottom:0!important;
    width:min(286px,84vw)!important;
    padding:22px 14px!important;
    overflow-y:auto!important;
    transform:translateX(-105%);
    visibility:hidden;
    opacity:0;
    transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1),opacity .2s ease,visibility .28s ease!important;
    z-index:140!important;
    box-shadow:18px 0 42px rgba(7,12,29,.28);
  }
  .sidebar.open{
    width:min(286px,84vw)!important;
    padding:22px 14px!important;
    transform:translateX(0);
    visibility:visible;
    opacity:1;
  }
  .sidebar.open:after{
    content:"";
    position:fixed;
    z-index:-1;
    top:0;
    right:-100vw;
    bottom:0;
    width:100vw;
    background:rgba(8,13,28,.42);
    backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .main{
    width:100%!important;
    max-width:none!important;
    margin-left:0!important;
    padding:22px 14px 34px!important;
  }
  .page-title{
    margin-bottom:19px;
    font-size:25px;
  }
  .stats{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
    gap:11px!important;
  }
  .stat{
    min-width:0;
    padding:16px 14px!important;
    border-radius:17px;
  }
  .stat-label{
    max-width:100%;
    font-size:10px;
    line-height:1.35;
  }
  .stat-value{font-size:23px}
  .card{
    width:100%;
    padding:17px!important;
    border-radius:18px;
  }
  .table-wrap{
    border:0;
    margin:0 -3px;
    border-radius:0;
  }
  .filter-row{
    flex-wrap:nowrap;
    overflow-x:auto;
    margin-right:-4px;
    padding-right:4px;
  }
  .filter-btn{flex:0 0 auto}
  .tournament-admin{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  .t-card{border-radius:18px}
  .t-body{padding:17px}
  .actions .btn{flex:0 0 auto}
  .modal-bg{padding:0!important;align-items:flex-end!important}
  .modal{
    width:100%;
    max-width:none;
    max-height:88vh;
    border-radius:24px 24px 0 0!important;
  }
}
@media(max-width:420px){
  .header .logo{max-width:145px}
  .header-user{max-width:104px}
  .page-title{font-size:23px}
  .stat-value{font-size:21px}
  .main{padding-left:12px!important;padding-right:12px!important}
  .btn.small{padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}
}
.tm-alert-bg{
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:600;

.subscription-admin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:18px;align-items:start}
.subscription-admin-grid>.card{min-width:0}
.subscription-duration-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 150px;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.subscription-duration-row input,.subscription-duration-row select{margin:0}
.subscription-custom-end{display:none;margin-bottom:12px}
.subscription-custom-end.show{display:block}
.subscription-form-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px}
#subscriptionPlanAdminList{display:grid;gap:12px}
.subscription-plan-card{padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(53,31,66,.06);overflow:hidden}
.subscription-plan-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
.subscription-plan-name{font-size:17px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:900;color:var(--ink);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.subscription-plan-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.subscription-plan-price{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--brand-deep);font-size:19px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
.subscription-availability{display:inline-flex;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}
.subscription-availability.off{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}
.subscription-plan-details{margin:13px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);white-space:pre-line;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.subscription-plan-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-top:14px}
.subscription-plan-actions .btn{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:9px 7px;font-size:11px;box-shadow:none!important}
.subscription-plan-users{display:none;margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}
.subscription-plan-users.open{display:grid;gap:8px}
.subscription-plan-user-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(0,.85fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface-soft)}
.subscription-plan-user-row b,.subscription-plan-user-row small{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.subscription-plan-user-row small{margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}.subscription-plan-user-state{text-align:right}
.subscription-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
.subscription-summary>div{min-width:0;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(53,31,66,.05)}
.subscription-summary small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.4;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.subscription-summary b{display:block;margin:5px 0;color:var(--ink);font-size:23px}
.subscription-user b,.subscription-user small{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.subscription-user small{margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.subscription-state{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;width:max-content;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:900}.subscription-state.active{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534}.subscription-state.blocked{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b}.subscription-state.expired{background:#e2e8f0;color:#475569}.subscription-activation-search{margin:0 0 12px}.subscription-action-btn{width:auto!important;min-width:64px!important;padding:6px 10px!important;font-size:10px!important;line-height:1.2;box-shadow:none!important}
.subscription-user-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;color:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.subscription-user-toggle:hover b{color:var(--brand-deep)}
.subscription-user-toggle.open .subscription-caret{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.subscription-caret{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .2s ease}
.sub-plan-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-weight:600}
.subscription-detail-row>td{padding:0 13px 12px}
.subscription-detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px 14px;margin-top:8px;padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-soft)}
.subscription-detail>div{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.subscription-detail small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;font-weight:900;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.subscription-detail b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.subscription-detail .subscription-detail-full{grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .subscription-admin-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.subscription-duration-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.subscription-plan-actions{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.subscription-summary{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.subscription-plan-user-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}.subscription-plan-user-state{text-align:left}
 #subscriptionActivationsPage .table-wrap{overflow:visible}#subscriptionActivationsPage table,#subscriptionActivationsPage thead,#subscriptionActivationsPage tbody,#subscriptionActivationsPage tr,#subscriptionActivationsPage td{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0!important}#subscriptionActivationsPage thead{display:none}#subscriptionActivationsPage tr{padding:12px 13px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface)}#subscriptionActivationsPage tr.sub-main-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:2px 10px;align-items:center}#subscriptionActivationsPage .sub-main-row td{display:block;padding:0;border:0!important}#subscriptionActivationsPage .sub-main-row td:nth-child(1){grid-column:1/-1}#subscriptionActivationsPage .sub-main-row td:nth-child(3){justify-self:end}#subscriptionActivationsPage .sub-main-row td:nth-child(4){grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:end;margin-top:3px}#subscriptionActivationsPage .sub-main-row.row-open{margin-bottom:0;border-radius:13px 13px 0 0}#subscriptionActivationsPage .subscription-detail-row{padding:0 13px 13px;margin:0 0 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:0;border-radius:0 0 13px 13px;background:var(--surface-soft)}#subscriptionActivationsPage .subscription-detail-row>td{padding:0;border:0!important}#subscriptionActivationsPage .subscription-detail{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px 12px;margin-top:0;padding:11px 0 0;border:0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="loginScreen" class="login-screen">
<div class="login-box">
<div class="logo">TMGame</div>
<div style="color:#64748b;margin-top:4px;font-size:14px">Admin Control Panel</div>
<div class="login-title">Admin Login</div>
<input id="adminEmail" type="email" placeholder="Admin Email">
<input id="adminPassword" type="password" placeholder="Password">
<button class="btn" style="width:100%;margin-top:10px" onclick="adminLogin()">Login</button>

<button class="create-admin-toggle" type="button" onclick="toggleCreateAdmin()">Create Admin ID</button>
<div id="createAdminForm" class="create-admin-form hidden">

<input id="newAdminPassword" type="password" minlength="6" placeholder="Create Password">

<button class="btn" type="button" style="width:100%" onclick="createAdminID()">Create Admin ID</button>

</div>

<div id="adminApp" class="hidden">
<header class="header">
<div class="header-left">
<button id="sidebarToggleBtn" class="menu" onclick="toggleSidebar()" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false">☰</button>
<div class="logo" style="font-size:20px">TMGame Admin</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px">
<button id="refreshBtn" class="menu" style="font-size:20px;line-height:1" onclick="refreshData()" title="Refresh data" aria-label="Refresh all data"><span class="refresh-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2.34 5.66"/><path d="M20 4v7h-7"/></svg></span></button>

</div>
</header>

<div id="sidebar" class="sidebar">
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openBankPage(this)">🏦 TMGame Bank</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openBankCustomerPage(this)">👤 Bank Customer</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openCategoriesPage(this)">🎮 Game Categories</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openAllTournaments(this)">🏆 Tournaments</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openLuckyDrawPage(this)">🎟️ Lucky Draw Match</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openSubscriptionsPage(this)">⭐ Add Subscription</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openSubscriptionActivationsPage(this)">📊 Subscription Activations</button>

<button class="side-btn" onclick="openAppUpdatePage(this)">⬆️ App Update</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('supportPage',this)">🎧 Support</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('referralPage',this)">🎁 Referrals</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('depositLimitPage',this)">🚫 Deposit Limit</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('leaderboardPage',this)">🥇 Leaderboard</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('socialPage',this)">🔗 Social Media Buttons</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openBannerPage(this)">🖼️ Slide Banner</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openNoticeBoardPage(this)">📢 Notice Board</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openGuidesPage(this)">📘 App Usage Guides</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openDesignPage(this)">🎨 Design Switcher</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openFirebaseConfigPage(this)">🔥 Firebase Config</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('settingsPage',this)">⚙️ Settings</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('systemPage',this)">🛠️ System Control</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="openPage('logsPage',this)">📝 Activity</button>
<button class="side-btn" id="desktopSiteBtn" onclick="toggleDesktopSite()">🖥️ Desktop Site: OFF</button>
<button class="side-btn" id="clearToggleBtn" onclick="toggleClearButtons()">🧹 Clear Buttons: OFF</button>
<button class="side-btn" onclick="logoutAdmin()">🚪 Logout</button>
</div>

<main class="main">

<!-- DASHBOARD -->
<section id="dashboardPage" class="page active">
<div class="page-title">Dashboard</div>
<div class="stats">
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Total Users</div><div id="statUsers" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Blocked Users</div><div id="statBlocked" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Pending Deposits</div><div id="statPendingDeposits" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Pending Withdrawals</div><div id="statPendingWithdrawals" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Tournaments</div><div id="statTournaments" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Joined Players</div><div id="statJoined" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Open Support</div><div id="statSupport" class="stat-value">0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Total Balance</div><div id="statCombinedTotal" class="stat-value">₹0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Available Balance</div><div id="statAvailableTotal" class="stat-value">₹0</div></div>
<div class="stat"><div class="stat-label">Winning Balance</div><div id="statWinningTotal" class="stat-value">₹0</div></div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- USERS -->
<section id="usersPage" class="page">
<div class="page-title">User Management</div>
<div class="card"><input id="userSearch" placeholder="Search name / email / UID / phone" oninput="renderUsers()"></div>
<div class="card">
<div class="table-wrap">
<table>
<thead><tr><th>User</th><th>UID</th><th>Phone</th><th>Wallet</th><th>Winning</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="usersTable"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- DEPOSITS -->
<section id="depositsPage" class="page">
<div class="page-title">Deposit Management</div>
<div class="card" id="autoApproveCard" style="border-top:3px solid #16a34a">
<div class="card-title">⚡ Auto Approve — Bank Statement Match</div>
<div style="font-size:13px;color:#64748b;margin-bottom:8px">Paste your bank statement <b>Google Sheets link</b> (sharing must be "Anyone with the link"). Press <b>Run</b> — the sheet is scanned and every Pending deposit whose Transaction ID / UTR matches the statement is listed below. IDs that were already used before are skipped automatically.</div>
<input id="autoSheetUrl" placeholder="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/..../edit">
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px">
<button class="btn green" id="autoRunBtn" onclick="runAutoApproveScan()">▶ Run Scan</button>
<button class="btn gray small" onclick="clearAutoApprove()">Clear</button>
</div>
<div id="autoProgressBox" class="hidden" style="margin-top:14px;padding:14px;border:1px dashed #cbd5e1;border-radius:14px;background:#f8fafc;text-align:center">
<div class="refresh-ico spin" style="margin:0 auto 6px"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-2.6-6.4"/><path d="M21 3v6h-6"/></svg></div>
<div id="autoProgressText" style="font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:#0f172a">Processing...</div>
</div>
<div id="autoResultBox" class="hidden" style="margin-top:14px">
<div id="autoSummary" style="font-size:13px;color:#334155;margin-bottom:10px"></div>
<div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>User</th><th>Transaction ID / UTR</th><th>Amount</th><th>Statement</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead><tbody id="autoMatchTable"></tbody></table></div>
<div style="margin-top:12px"><button class="btn green" id="autoApproveAllBtn" onclick="approveAllMatched()">✔ Approve All Matched</button></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="filter-row">
<button class="filter-btn active" onclick="setDepositFilter('All',this)">All</button>
<button class="filter-btn" onclick="setDepositFilter('Pending',this)">Pending</button>
<button class="filter-btn" onclick="setDepositFilter('Approved',this)">Approved</button>
<button class="filter-btn" onclick="setDepositFilter('Rejected',this)">Rejected</button>
<button class="btn small red clear-toggle" style="display:none" onclick="clearProcessedDeposits()">Clear</button>
</div>
<input id="depositSearch" placeholder="Search by Name or User ID" oninput="renderDeposits()" style="margin-bottom:14px">
<div class="table-wrap">
<table>
<thead><tr><th>User</th><th>UID</th><th>Amount</th><th>Reference</th><th>Status</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="depositsTable"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- WITHDRAWALS -->

<button class="filter-btn active" onclick="setWithdrawalFilter('All',this)">All</button>

</div>
<input id="withdrawalSearch" placeholder="Search by Name or User ID" oninput="renderWithdrawals()" style="margin-bottom:14px">
<div class="table-wrap">
<table>
<thead><tr><th>User</th><th>UID</th><th>Amount</th><th>UPI</th><th>Status</th><th>Tx</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead>
<tbody id="withdrawalsTable"></tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<!-- GAME CATEGORIES -->
<section id="categoriesPage" class="page">
<div class="page-title">Game Categories</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" id="categoryFormTitle">Create Category</div>
<div class="form-grid">
<input id="cName" placeholder="Tournament / Category Name (e.g. Free Fire)" class="full">
<input id="cImage" placeholder="Category Image URL" class="full">
</div>
<button class="btn" id="categorySaveBtn" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="saveCategory()">Create Category</button>

</div>
<div class="tournament-admin" id="categoriesList"></div>
</section>

<!-- TOURNAMENTS -->

<div class="page-title" id="tournamentsPageTitle">Tournament Management</div>
<div class="card" id="categoryContextBar" style="display:none">
<button class="btn gray small" onclick="openCategoriesPage()">← Back to Categories</button>
<span style="margin-left:12px;font-weight:800" id="categoryContextName"></span>
</div>
<div class="card">
<div class="card-title" id="tournamentFormTitle">Create Tournament</div>
<div class="form-grid">
<input id="tName" placeholder="Tournament Name" class="full">

<input id="tMode" placeholder="Mode (type anything e.g. Solo, Duo, Custom)">

<input id="tMap" placeholder="Map / Location">

<div class="full">
  <label class="form-label">Close Match Schedule</label>
  <input id="tDateTime" type="datetime-local">
</div>

<div class="full">
  <label class="form-label">Starting Match Schedule</label>
  <input id="tRegistrationEnd" type="datetime-local">
</div>

<div class="full">
  <label class="form-label">Match Ending</label>
  <input id="tMatchEnding" type="datetime-local">
</div>

  <option value="Paid">Paid</option>

</section>

<!-- APP UPDATE -->
<section id="appUpdatePage" class="page">
<div class="page-title">App Update</div>

<div class="card-title">Publish an App Update</div>

/* ============ AUTO APPROVE — GOOGLE SHEET BANK STATEMENT MATCH ============ */
let autoMatches = [];

function autoNorm(v){ return String(v==null?"":v).toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,""); }

function autoParseCsv(text){
  const rows=[]; let row=[], cell="", q=false;
  for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){
    const c=text[i];
    if(q){
      if(c==='"'){ if(text[i+1]==='"'){ cell+='"'; i++; } else q=false; }
      else cell+=c;
    } else if(c==='"') q=true;
    else if(c===','){ row.push(cell); cell=""; }
    else if(c==='\n'){ row.push(cell); rows.push(row); row=[]; cell=""; }
    else if(c!=='\r') cell+=c;
  }
  row.push(cell); rows.push(row);
  return rows.filter(r=>r.some(x=>String(x).trim()!==""));
}

function autoSheetCsvUrls(url){
  const m = String(url||"").match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if(!m) return null;
  const id = m[1];
  const g = String(url).match(/[#&?]gid=([0-9]+)/);
  const gid = g ? g[1] : "0";
  return [
    `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${id}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${gid}`,
    `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${id}/export?format=csv&gid=${gid}`
  ];
}

window.runAutoApproveScan = async function(){
  const url = (document.getElementById("autoSheetUrl")?.value||"").trim();
  const urls = autoSheetCsvUrls(url);
  if(!urls){ alert("Please paste a valid Google Sheets link."); return; }

  const prog = document.getElementById("autoProgressBox");
  const ptxt = document.getElementById("autoProgressText");
  const resBox = document.getElementById("autoResultBox");
  const btn = document.getElementById("autoRunBtn");
  resBox.classList.add("hidden");
  prog.classList.remove("hidden");
  ptxt.textContent = "Reading Google Sheet...";
  btn.disabled = true;

  let rows = null, err = "";
  for(const u of urls){
    try{
      const r = await fetch(u);
      if(!r.ok){ err = "HTTP " + r.status; continue; }
      const t = await r.text();
      if(/<html/i.test(t.slice(0,200))){ err = "Sheet is not public"; continue; }
      rows = autoParseCsv(t); break;
    }catch(e){ err = e.message || "Network error"; }
  }

  if(!rows){
    prog.classList.add("hidden"); btn.disabled = false;
    alert("Could not read the sheet ("+err+").\nOpen the sheet → Share → General access → Anyone with the link → Viewer, then try again.");
    return;
  }

  ptxt.textContent = "Refreshing deposits...";
  try{ await loadDeposits(); }catch(e){}

  ptxt.textContent = "Scanning "+rows.length+" statement rows...";
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));

  /* statement rows -> normalized text + amounts */
  const stmt = rows.map(r=>{
    const cells = r.map(c=>String(c||"").trim());
    const nums = [];
    cells.forEach(c=>{
      const n = Number(String(c).replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g,""));
      if(String(c).replace(/[^0-9.]/g,"") !== "" && isFinite(n)) nums.push(Math.abs(n));
    });
    return { raw: cells.join(" | "), norm: autoNorm(cells.join(" ")), nums };
  });

  /* IDs already used before (any non-pending deposit) + duplicate pending IDs */
  const usedIds = new Set();
  deposits.forEach(d=>{ if(String(d.status||"Pending")!=="Pending"){ const k=autoNorm(d.txid); if(k) usedIds.add(k); } });

  const pending = newestFirst(deposits.filter(d=>String(d.status||"Pending")==="Pending"));
  const seen = new Set();
  const matched = [];
  let skippedDup = 0, noMatch = 0, noId = 0;

  pending.forEach(d=>{
    const key = autoNorm(d.txid);
    if(!key || key.length < 6){ noId++; return; }
    if(usedIds.has(key) || seen.has(key)){ skippedDup++; return; }
    seen.add(key);
    const hit = stmt.find(s => s.norm.includes(key));
    if(!hit){ noMatch++; return; }
    const amt = Number(d.amount||0);

window.approveDeposit = async function(id, silent){
  if(depositBusy.has(id)) return;
  const deposit = deposits.find(d=>d.id===id);
  if(!deposit || deposit.status!=="Pending") return;
  depositBusy.add(id); lockDepositButtons(id, true);
  const userId = deposit.userId;
  const amount = Number(deposit.amount||0);

  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const depRef = doc(db, "deposits", id);
      const depSnap = await transaction.get(depRef);
      if(!depSnap.exists() || String(depSnap.data().status||"Pending")!=="Pending") throw new Error("ALREADY_PROCESSED");
      const userRef = doc(db, "users", userId);
      const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if(!userSnap.exists()) throw new Error("User not found");

      const user = userSnap.data();
      let bal = Number(user.walletBalance || 0);
      let newBal = bal + amount;
      let userUpdates = { walletBalance: newBal };

      let referrerRef = null;
      let refBal = 0;
      let shouldReward = false;

      if(user.referredBy && !user.firstDepositRewarded){
        referrerRef = doc(db, "users", user.referredBy);
        const referrerSnap = await transaction.get(referrerRef);
        if(referrerSnap.exists()){
          refBal = Number(referrerSnap.data().walletBalance || 0);
          const bonus = Number(appSettings.referralBonus || 0);
          newBal += bonus;
          userUpdates.walletBalance = newBal;
          userUpdates.firstDepositRewarded = true;
          shouldReward = true;
        }
      }

      transaction.update(userRef, userUpdates);
      transaction.update(doc(db, "deposits", id), {
        status: "Approved",
        approvedAt: serverTimestamp(),
        approvedBy: admin.uid
      });

      if(shouldReward && referrerRef){
        transaction.update(referrerRef, { walletBalance: refBal + Number(appSettings.referralBonus || 0) });
      }
    });

    await notifyUser(userId, "Deposit approved", `Your deposit of ₹${amount} has been approved and credited to your wallet.`);
    await addLog("Deposit Approved", `₹${amount} - ${userId}`);
    await loadUsers();
    await loadDeposits();
    renderUsers();
    renderDeposits();
    calculateDashboard();
    if(!silent) alert("Deposit approved + wallet credited");
  }catch(e){
    if(e && e.message==="ALREADY_PROCESSED"){
      await loadDeposits(); renderDeposits(); calculateDashboard();
      if(!silent) alert("This deposit was already processed.");
      return;
    }
    console.error(e);
    if(!silent) alert("Failed to approve: " + (e.message || "Unknown error"));
    if(silent) throw e;
  }finally{
    depositBusy.delete(id); lockDepositButtons(id, false);
  }
};

window.rejectDeposit = async function(id){
  if(depositBusy.has(id)) return;
  const deposit = deposits.find(d=>d.id===id);
  if(deposit && String(deposit.status||"Pending")!=="Pending") return;
  depositBusy.add(id); lockDepositButtons(id, true);
  try{
    const reason = prompt("Reject reason:");
    if(reason === null) return;
    let done = false;
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const depRef = doc(db,"deposits",id);
      const depSnap = await transaction.get(depRef);
      if(!depSnap.exists() || String(depSnap.data().status||"Pending")!=="Pending") return;
      transaction.update(depRef, { status:"Rejected", rejectReason:reason, rejectedAt:serverTimestamp() });
      done = true;
    });
    if(done){
      await notifyUser(deposit?.userId, "Deposit rejected", `Your deposit of ₹${Number(deposit?.amount||0)} was rejected.${reason ? " Reason: " + reason : ""}`);
      if(deposit?.userId) await registerRejection(deposit.userId);
    }
    await loadDeposits(); await loadUsers();
    renderDeposits(); renderUsers(); renderDepositLimit(); calculateDashboard();
  }catch(e){
    console.error(e); alert("Failed to reject: " + (e.message || "Unknown error"));
  }finally{
    depositBusy.delete(id); lockDepositButtons(id, false);
  }
};

const REJECTION_LIMIT = 5;
async function registerRejection(userId){
  try{
    const ref = doc(db,"users",userId);
    const snap = await getDoc(ref);
    if(!snap.exists()) return;
    const count = Number(snap.data().rejectionCount || 0) + 1;
    const upd = { rejectionCount: count, isRestricted: count >= REJECTION_LIMIT, lastRejectedAt: serverTimestamp() };
    if(count >= REJECTION_LIMIT) upd.restrictedAt = serverTimestamp();
    await updateDoc(ref, upd);
    if(count >= REJECTION_LIMIT) await addLog("User Restricted (5 rejections)", userId);
  }catch(e){ console.error("registerRejection", e); }
}

window.approveWithdrawal = async function(id){
  const w = withdrawals.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!w || w.status!=="Pending") return;
  const userId = w.userId;
  const amount = Number(w.amount||0);
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",userId);
      const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if(!userSnap.exists()) throw new Error("User not found");
      if(!w.balanceDeducted && !w.fundsHeld){
        const winBal = Number(userSnap.data().winningBalance||0);
        if(winBal < amount) throw new Error("Insufficient Winning Balance");
        transaction.update(userRef, { winningBalance: winBal - amount });
      }
      transaction.update(doc(db,"withdrawals",id), { status:"Approved", fundsHeld:true, approvedAt:serverTimestamp() });
    });
    await notifyUser(userId, "Withdrawal approved", `Your withdrawal of ₹${amount} has been approved and is being processed.`);
    await loadUsers(); await loadWithdrawals(); renderUsers(); renderWithdrawals(); calculateDashboard();
    alert("Withdrawal approved");
  }catch(e){ alert(e.message || "Failed"); }
};
window.rejectWithdrawal = async function(id){
  const w = withdrawals.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!w || w.status!=="Pending") return;
  const reason = prompt("Reject reason:") || "";
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",w.userId);
      const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if(userSnap.exists() && (w.balanceDeducted || w.fundsHeld)){
        const winBal = Number(userSnap.data().winningBalance||0);
        transaction.update(userRef, { winningBalance: winBal + Number(w.amount||0) });
      }
      transaction.update(doc(db,"withdrawals",id), { status:"Rejected", rejectReason:reason, rejectedAt:serverTimestamp() });
    });
    await notifyUser(w.userId, "Withdrawal rejected", `Your withdrawal of ₹${Number(w.amount||0)} was rejected and the amount was returned to your wallet.${reason ? " Reason: " + reason : ""}`);
    await registerRejection(w.userId);

async function processCancelRefunds(tournamentId){
  const parts = participants.filter(p => p.tournamentId === tournamentId && !p.refunded && Number(p.entryFee||0) > 0);

    try{
      await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
        const userRef = doc(db,"users", p.userId);
        const partRef = doc(db,"tournamentParticipants", p.id);
        const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
        if(!userSnap.exists()) return;
        const bal = Number(userSnap.data().walletBalance||0);
        const fee = Number(p.entryFee||0);
        transaction.update(userRef, { walletBalance: bal + fee });
        transaction.update(partRef, { result: "REFUND", refunded: true, refundAmount: fee, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
      });
      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId: p.userId, type: "tournament_refund", amount: Number(p.entryFee||0), reason: "Tournament cancelled - entry fee refund", createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
      await notifyUser(p.userId, "Match cancelled", `Match Cancelled \u2013 Entry fee of ₹${Number(p.entryFee||0)} refunded to your wallet.`);
    }catch(e){ console.error("Refund failed for", p.userId, e); }
  }
  await loadParticipants(); await loadUsers();
}

window.cancelUser = async function(tournamentId, participantId, userId){

  if(String(p.result||"").toUpperCase() === "CANCELLED") return alert("This user is already cancelled");
  const fee = Number(p.entryFee || 0);
  if(!confirm(fee > 0 ? `Cancel this user and refund ₹${fee} to their wallet?` : "Cancel this user? (Free tournament – no refund)")) return;
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",userId);
      const partRef = doc(db,"tournamentParticipants",participantId);
      const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
      if(!userSnap.exists()) throw new Error("User not found");
      if(fee > 0 && !p.refunded){
        const bal = Number(userSnap.data().walletBalance||0);
        transaction.update(userRef, { walletBalance: bal + fee });
        transaction.update(partRef, { result: "CANCELLED", cancelled: true, refunded: true, refundAmount: fee, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
      } else {
        transaction.update(partRef, { result: "CANCELLED", cancelled: true, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
      }
    });

      await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
        userId, type: "tournament_refund", amount: fee, reason: "Match cancelled - entry fee refund", createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });
    }
    await notifyUser(userId, "Match cancelled", `Match Cancelled \u2013 Entry fee of ₹${fee} refunded to your wallet.`);
    await addLog("User Cancelled", `${userId} cancelled${fee>0?` – ₹${fee} refunded`:""}`);
    await loadParticipants(); await loadUsers();

    calculateDashboard();

};

window.cancelAllUsers = async function(tournamentId){
  const list = participants.filter(x => x.tournamentId === tournamentId && String(x.result||"").toUpperCase() !== "CANCELLED");
  if(!list.length) return alert("No users left to cancel");
  if(!confirm(`Cancel all ${list.length} joined user(s) and refund their entry fees?`)) return;
  let done = 0, failed = 0;
  for(const p of list){
    const fee = Number(p.entryFee || 0);
    try{
      await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
        const userRef = doc(db,"users",p.userId);
        const partRef = doc(db,"tournamentParticipants",p.id);
        const userSnap = await transaction.get(userRef);
        if(!userSnap.exists()) throw new Error("User not found");
        if(fee > 0 && !p.refunded){
          const bal = Number(userSnap.data().walletBalance||0);
          transaction.update(userRef, { walletBalance: bal + fee });
          transaction.update(partRef, { result: "CANCELLED", cancelled: true, refunded: true, refundAmount: fee, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
        } else {
          transaction.update(partRef, { result: "CANCELLED", cancelled: true, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
        }
      });
      if(fee > 0 && !p.refunded){
        await addDoc(collection(db,"walletTransactions"), {
          userId: p.userId, type: "tournament_refund", amount: fee, reason: "Match cancelled - entry fee refund", createdAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
      }
      await notifyUser(p.userId, "Match cancelled", `Match Cancelled \u2013 Entry fee of ₹${fee} refunded to your wallet.`);
      done++;
    }catch(e){ console.error("Cancel failed for", p.userId, e); failed++; }
  }

  await loadParticipants(); await loadUsers();

window.cleanBankHistory=async function(){
  const input=prompt("Delete completed / rejected transfer records older than how many days?\n(Enter 0 to delete all completed & rejected records)","30");
  if(input===null) return;
  const days=Number(input);
  if(!Number.isFinite(days)||days<0) return alert("Enter a valid number of days");
  const cutoff=Date.now()-days*86400000;
  const removable=walletTransfers.filter(t=>{
    if(["Pending","Stuck","Flagged"].includes(t.status)) return false;
    const ms=t.createdAt?.seconds?t.createdAt.seconds*1000:(t.createdAt?new Date(t.createdAt).getTime():0);
    return days===0 ? true : (ms>0 && ms<cutoff);
  });
  if(!removable.length) return alert("Nothing to clean. No old completed / rejected records found.");
  if(!confirm(`Delete ${removable.length} transaction record(s) permanently? This cannot be undone.`)) return;
  let done=0, failed=0;
  for(const t of removable){
    try{ await deleteDoc(doc(db,"walletTransfers",t.id)); done++; }catch(e){ failed++; }
  }
  await addLog("Bank History Cleaned", `${done} record(s) deleted`);
  await loadWalletTransfers();
  renderBank();
  alert(`Cleaned ${done} record(s)${failed?`, ${failed} failed`:""}`);
};

window.declareLuckyWinner = async function(ticketId){
  if(!luckyCurrentDraw) return;
  const input = document.getElementById("ldWin_" + ticketId);
  const amount = Number(input?.value || 0);
  if(!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return alert("Enter a valid win amount");
  const drawId = luckyCurrentDraw.id;
  try{
    await runTransaction(db, async tx => {
      const ticketRef = doc(db,"luckyTickets",ticketId);
      const drawRef = doc(db,"luckyDraws",drawId);
      const ts = await tx.get(ticketRef);
      if(!ts.exists()) throw new Error("Ticket not found");
      const ticket = ts.data();
      if(ticket.status === "won") throw new Error("This ticket is already a winner");
      if(ticket.status === "lost") throw new Error("This ticket is already marked as loss");
      const ds = await tx.get(drawRef);
      const draw = ds.exists() ? ds.data() : {};
      const limit = Number(draw.winnerLimit || luckyCurrentDraw.winnerLimit || 0);
      const current = Number(draw.winnersCount || 0);
      if(limit && current >= limit) throw new Error("Winner limit already reached");
      const userRef = doc(db,"users",ticket.uid);
      const us = await tx.get(userRef);
      if(!us.exists()) throw new Error("User account not found");
      tx.update(userRef, { winningBalance: Number(us.data().winningBalance||0) + amount });
      tx.update(ticketRef, { status:"won", winAmount: amount, celebrationSeen:false, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
      if(ds.exists()){
        const nextCount = current + 1;
        tx.update(drawRef, {
          winnersCount: nextCount,
          resultDeclared: limit > 0 && nextCount >= limit,
          closedAt: limit > 0 && nextCount >= limit ? serverTimestamp() : (draw.closedAt || null)
        });
      }
    });
    try{ await notifyUser(luckyParticipants.find(t => t.id === ticketId)?.uid, "Lucky Draw Winner!", `You won ₹${amount.toFixed(2)} in ${luckyCurrentDraw.name||"Lucky Draw"}. Amount added to your Winning Balance.`); }catch(e){}
    try{ await addLog("Lucky Draw", `Winner declared ₹${amount} on ${luckyCurrentDraw.name||""}`); }catch(e){}
    await loadLuckyDraws();
    luckyCurrentDraw = luckyDrawList.find(x => x.id === drawId) || luckyCurrentDraw;
    await loadLuckyParticipants(drawId);
    await finalizeLuckyLosers(drawId);
    renderLuckyParticipants();
    renderLuckyDrawList();
  }catch(e){ alert(e.message || "Could not declare winner"); }
};

async function finalizeLuckyLosers(drawId){
  const limit = Number(luckyCurrentDraw?.winnerLimit || 0);
  const winners = luckyParticipants.filter(t => t.status === "won").length;
  if(!limit || winners < limit) return;
  const pending = luckyParticipants.filter(t => (t.status || "joined") === "joined");
  for(const t of pending){
    try{
      await updateDoc(doc(db,"luckyTickets",t.id), { status:"lost", winAmount:0, celebrationSeen:true, resultAt: serverTimestamp() });
      t.status = "lost";
    }catch(e){}

}

  if(durationUnit==="custom"&&(!Number.isFinite(customEndAt)||customEndAt<=Date.now())) return alert("Choose a future plan end date and time.");
  const payload={name,amount,details,durationValue:durationUnit==="custom"?0:durationValue,durationUnit,customEndAt,enabled:true,updatedAt:serverTimestamp()};
  try{
    if(editingSubscriptionPlanId) await setDoc(doc(db,"subscriptionPlans",editingSubscriptionPlanId),payload,{merge:true});
    else await addDoc(collection(db,"subscriptionPlans"),{...payload,createdAt:serverTimestamp()});
    alert(editingSubscriptionPlanId?"Subscription updated":"Subscription created"); cancelEditSubscriptionPlan(); await Promise.all([loadSubscriptionPlans(),loadSubscriptionActivations()]); renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin();
  }catch(e){ alert(e.message||"Could not save subscription"); }
};
window.editSubscriptionPlan=function(id){const p=subscriptionPlans.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;editingSubscriptionPlanId=id;document.getElementById("subscriptionName").value=p.name||"";document.getElementById("subscriptionAmount").value=p.amount||"";document.getElementById("subscriptionDetails").value=p.details||"";document.getElementById("subscriptionDurationValue").value=p.durationValue||"";document.getElementById("subscriptionDurationUnit").value=p.durationUnit||"days";document.getElementById("subscriptionCustomEnd").value=p.customEndAt?localDateTimeValue(p.customEndAt):"";toggleSubscriptionCustomEnd();document.getElementById("subscriptionFormTitle").textContent="Edit Plan";document.getElementById("subscriptionSaveBtn").textContent="Update Plan";document.getElementById("subscriptionCancelBtn").style.display="inline-flex";window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"});};
window.cancelEditSubscriptionPlan=function(){editingSubscriptionPlanId=null;["subscriptionName","subscriptionAmount","subscriptionDetails","subscriptionDurationValue","subscriptionCustomEnd"].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value="");document.getElementById("subscriptionDurationUnit").value="days";toggleSubscriptionCustomEnd();document.getElementById("subscriptionFormTitle").textContent="Create Plan";document.getElementById("subscriptionSaveBtn").textContent="Create Plan";document.getElementById("subscriptionCancelBtn").style.display="none";};
window.toggleSubscriptionPlan=async function(id){const p=subscriptionPlans.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;await updateDoc(doc(db,"subscriptionPlans",id),{enabled:p.enabled===false,updatedAt:serverTimestamp()});await loadSubscriptionPlans();renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin();};
window.deleteSubscriptionPlan=async function(id){if(!confirm("Delete this plan? Existing user history will remain."))return;await deleteDoc(doc(db,"subscriptionPlans",id));await loadSubscriptionPlans();renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin();};
window.toggleSubscriptionPlanUsers=function(id){expandedSubscriptionPlanId=expandedSubscriptionPlanId===id?null:id;renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin();};
function subscriptionPlanUsersMarkup(planId){const rows=subscriptionActivations.filter(x=>x.planId===planId);if(!rows.length)return '<div class="empty">No users joined this plan yet</div>';return rows.map(x=>{const person=users.find(u=>u.id===x.userId)||{},state=subscriptionStatus(x);return `<div class="subscription-plan-user-row"><div><b>${esc(x.userName||person.name||"User")}</b><small>${esc(x.userEmail||person.email||x.userId||"")}</small></div><div><b>${formatDate(Number(x.activatedAt||0))}</b><small>Ends ${formatDate(Number(x.expiresAt||0))}</small></div><div class="subscription-plan-user-state"><span class="subscription-state ${state.toLowerCase()}">${state}</span></div></div>`;}).join("");}
window.renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin=function(){const box=document.getElementById("subscriptionPlanAdminList");if(!box)return;if(!subscriptionPlans.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty">No subscription plans created</div>';return;}box.innerHTML=subscriptionPlans.map(p=>{const joined=subscriptionActivations.filter(x=>x.planId===p.id).length,open=expandedSubscriptionPlanId===p.id;return `<div class="subscription-plan-card"><div class="subscription-plan-head"><div><div class="subscription-plan-name">${esc(p.name||"Plan")}</div><div class="subscription-plan-meta"><span>${esc(subscriptionDurationText(p))}</span><span class="subscription-availability ${p.enabled===false?"off":""}">${p.enabled===false?"Unavailable":"Available"}</span></div></div><div class="subscription-plan-price">₹${Number(p.amount||0).toFixed(2)}</div></div><div class="subscription-plan-details">${esc(p.details||"")}</div><div class="subscription-plan-actions"><button class="btn small orange" onclick="editSubscriptionPlan('${p.id}')">Edit</button><button class="btn small ${p.enabled===false?"green":"gray"}" onclick="toggleSubscriptionPlan('${p.id}')">${p.enabled===false?"Enable":"Disable"}</button><button class="btn small red" onclick="deleteSubscriptionPlan('${p.id}')">Delete</button><button class="btn small" onclick="toggleSubscriptionPlanUsers('${p.id}')">${open?"Hide users":`Users (${joined})`}</button></div><div class="subscription-plan-users ${open?"open":""}">${open?subscriptionPlanUsersMarkup(p.id):""}</div></div>`;}).join("");};
window.toggleSubscriptionBlock=async function(id){const item=subscriptionActivations.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!item)return;try{await updateDoc(doc(db,"subscriptionActivations",id),{blocked:item.blocked!==true,blockedAt:item.blocked===true?null:Date.now(),blockedBy:admin.uid,updatedAt:serverTimestamp()});await loadSubscriptionActivations();renderSubscriptionActivationsAdmin();renderSubscriptionPlansAdmin();}catch(e){alert(e.message||"Could not update subscription");}};
var expandedSubscriptionActivationId=null;
window.toggleSubscriptionDetail=function(id){expandedSubscriptionActivationId=expandedSubscriptionActivationId===id?null:id;renderSubscriptionActivationsAdmin();};
window.renderSubscriptionActivationsAdmin=function(){
  const summary=document.getElementById("subscriptionActivationSummary"),body=document.getElementById("subscriptionActivationTable");if(!summary||!body)return;
  const active=subscriptionActivations.filter(x=>subscriptionStatus(x)==="Active").length;
  const search=(document.getElementById("subscriptionActivationSearch")?.value||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  const visible=subscriptionActivations.filter(x=>{const person=users.find(u=>u.id===x.userId)||{};return !search||[x.userName,person.name,x.userEmail,person.email,x.userId,x.planName,x.durationLabel].some(v=>String(v||"").toLowerCase().includes(search));});
  summary.innerHTML=`<div><small>Total activations</small><b>${subscriptionActivations.length}</b></div><div><small>Currently active</small><b>${active}</b></div><div><small>Plans</small><b>${subscriptionPlans.length}</b></div>`;
  if(!visible.length){body.innerHTML=`<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty">${search?"No matching users":"No subscription activations"}</td></tr>`;return;}
  body.innerHTML=visible.map(x=>{const state=subscriptionStatus(x),person=users.find(u=>u.id===x.userId)||{},open=expandedSubscriptionActivationId===x.id;const detailRow=open?`<tr class="subscription-detail-row"><td colspan="4"><div class="subscription-detail"><div class="subscription-detail-full"><small>User ID</small><b>${esc(x.userId||"—")}</b></div><div><small>Email</small><b>${esc(x.userEmail||person.email||"—")}</b></div><div><small>Plan</small><b>${esc(x.planName||"Plan")}</b></div><div><small>Duration</small><b>${esc(x.durationLabel||"—")}</b></div><div><small>Amount</small><b>₹${Number(x.amountPaid||0).toFixed(2)}</b></div><div><small>Activated</small><b>${formatDate(Number(x.activatedAt||0))}</b></div><div><small>Expires</small><b>${formatDate(Number(x.expiresAt||0))}</b></div><div><small>Status</small><b>${state}</b></div></div></td></tr>`:"";return `<tr class="sub-main-row${open?" row-open":""}"><td><button class="subscription-user-toggle${open?" open":""}" onclick="toggleSubscriptionDetail('${x.id}')" title="Tap to view details"><span class="subscription-user"><b>${esc(x.userName||person.name||"User")}</b><small>${esc(x.userEmail||person.email||x.userId||"")}</small></span><span class="subscription-caret">▾</span></button></td><td><span class="sub-plan-label">${esc(x.planName||"Plan")}</span></td><td><span class="subscription-state ${state.toLowerCase()}">${state}</span></td><td>${state==="Expired"?"—":`<button class="btn small subscription-action-btn ${x.blocked===true?"green":"red"}" onclick="toggleSubscriptionBlock('${x.id}')">${x.blocked===true?"Unblock":"Block"}</button>`}</td></tr>${detailRow}`;}).join("");
};

</script>
<script>
/* Branded visual replacement for the existing informational alert() calls. */
(function(){
  const pending = [];
  let active = false;
  function showNext(){
    if(active || !pending.length) return;
    active = true;
    const message = pending.shift();
    const backdrop = document.createElement("div");
    backdrop.className = "tm-alert-bg";
    const card = document.createElement("div");
    card.className = "tm-alert-card";
    const kicker = document.createElement("div");
    kicker.className = "tm-alert-kicker";
    kicker.textContent = "TMGame Admin";
    const text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "tm-alert-message";
    text.textContent = String(message ?? "");
    const footer = document.createElement("div");
    footer.className = "tm-alert-footer";
    const ok = document.createElement("button");
    ok.className = "tm-alert-ok";
    ok.type = "button";
    ok.textContent = "OK";
    footer.appendChild(ok);
    card.append(kicker,text,footer);
    backdrop.appendChild(card);
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
    const close = () => {
      backdrop.remove();
      active = false;
      showNext();
    };
    ok.addEventListener("click",close);
    backdrop.addEventListener("click",event => { if(event.target === backdrop) close(); });
    ok.focus();
  }
  window.alert = function(message){
    pending.push(message);
    showNext();
  };
})();
</script>
